items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: even my teacher knew that Beethoven, Bach and I were not wed

ctx.x: Just keep playing a lick from the tune.

I play some — I studied classical music. I was not a music major but I studied piano all through college. And my shining hour was, you know, a couple of Chopin etudes and scherzos and when I was in college, because the best thing that happened to me was a practice room in a building away from anything to distract me. And I can’t believe that I was able to practice and learn and memorize these things. But after that I really knew, and even my teacher knew that Beethoven, Bach and I were not wed and that I was much…
Well you’re going to be playing on your birthday, right?
